# WebSocket flow control and conversation continuity

This prerelease contains three targeted upstream adaptations:

- [#2711](https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2711): prevent native WebSocket
  burst loss with negotiated receive credits. Slow consumers pause socket reads
  while send/close/cancel commands and other sockets continue. Cancellation and
  ambiguous credit writes fail safely. Diagnostics include an allowlisted phase,
  close code and event/byte counts, without private exception or close-reason text.
- [#2731](https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2731): finish the context-coverage
  inheritance fix and snapshot coverage before asynchronous admission. A partial
  conversation cannot become a supposedly complete history through an injected
  anchor, and a missing anchor cannot trigger a context-losing replay.
- [#2569](https://github.com/Soju06/codex-lb/pull/2569): keep developer messages in
  Responses input so continuation can retain them; preserve existing system and
  Responses Lite normalization rules.

These changes fix reproduced transport/continuity defects. A genuinely missing
upstream response may still return `previous_response_not_found`; the client
must resend complete context. This release does not claim to eliminate every
upstream WebSocket 1011 closure. Production deployment remains operator-managed.

## Replacement publication

At the repository owner's explicit request, this replaces the earlier withdrawn
`v1.26.0-beta.1` build from `3a6b1187d03010bae447a9c654a2c8a066a6469c`.
The old Docker image index was
`sha256:f4495212a108cb527b2b7f9a7847de5982fa48e0b1b4565981113d535a8cbc6d`.
Pull the tag again to obtain the replacement image. The image revision label
identifies the source commit. Stable `latest` remains unchanged.

This replacement publishes GitHub assets, Docker and Helm. **It is not uploaded
to PyPI**, because the original version filenames were already published.
Python archives attached here belong to this replacement build; use the attached
checksums to distinguish them from the withdrawn artifacts.

## Verification

Release publication requires both amd64 and arm64 native container startup
checks, upgrade checks from the original beta.9 image, and the existing image
vulnerability gate. The source includes native burst/cancellation tests,
WebSocket context-race regressions, developer-message route regressions and
privacy checks. See the linked Actions run and OpenSpec verification records for
the exact candidate results. No live production container was modified to test
this release.
